notes.title: Super Army of Tentacles, progress update + news
notes.content:
So. 
Dunno if this announcement is really warranted. Just want to let people know what is going on. 

[b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] has three main mechanics: skills/attributes, Word Battles, and Armies.

Well, it did. See, I started work on the project when things were.... let's say, different in the USA, and that, in turn, fueled the direction of the thing. We had already wanted to do something new with AoT 1's army mechanic, but do it better than the first game. Do it with all the game dev we had learned over the years since we've started. So I felt that my internal anger was a good fuel for said mechanic. Who doesn't love a good 'throw out the bad guys' story?

While the main story of the game is still 'the humans somehow occupied Monster Land', after recent events, I just don't feel good about a mechanic where you pre-meditatively build up militias to take over areas. We talked about this, and the bottom line is that we feel that even though the Army mechanic would have been solid, it would have taken away from the main gameplay loop of the first two games. Even though there was a final Invasion mechanic in the first game, the way you recruited your army was never the focal point. The focals were the Word Battles. 

At the end of the day, real people make games, and we don't want to be making a game that we feel isn't up to snuff or is pushed in two different directions. This is the last in the trilogy for us. We know more now and want to do it right, as both a stand alone title and a series cap.

This also allows us to put greater focus on the idea of reactivity to your choices in the world's hubs. Which is cool. 

I'm writing this because, even though it wasn't the selling point of the game or even showcased in screenshots or the trailer, it was in the initial store description and there were shots of it in the trailer and on the screenshot gallery. We've already updated the gallery, but will also be updating the trailer shortly. 

This really doesn't affect the already delayed release date of 2022. If anything, it clarifies a release date. If anything, at max what it means is this will release post-summer 2022, but I honestly don't think that's a concern.

notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082690/Super_Army_of_Tentacles_Not_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim
[h1]What is it?[/h1]
[b]Behold![/b] The final entry in the main Army of Tentacles series, which can be played as either a sequel to [b]Super Army of Tentacles 3[/b], or as a standalone title entirely! The title was almost going to be Army of Tentacles 2, but we thought that a fresh coat of paint was the best route. The title we landed on is an amalgamation of the first two games.

[h1]Will there be a GOAT Edition and/or Cheat Mode?[/h1]
No.

[h1]How standalone a title is it?[/h1]
There are going to be things that definitely resonate with and will have different meanings for returning players, but the story is written with new players in mind. It 100% works as a sequel, but is written more like a parallel story to the main storyline that the first two games established, if that makes sense.  You won't need to know who this is or why that is going on.

[h1]2021 Games[/h1]
With that, 2021's titles are pretty much announced. It was honestly just going to be Super Army next year, but then Hamlet and Furries/Bears 2 slipped. We might do a Halloween game, but other than that, this is the lineup.

notes.title: AoT Upgrade news - end of the line?
notes.content:
Okay, so here's the deal:

The Army of Tentacles 1 remaster is hitting some snags. The easiest to work on right now is that it is getting way too big file size-wise - bigger than the original size by far. So I don't think it is fair to drastically change the file size for an existing userbase. Which leaves the project with three options:

1) [b]Release it as a separate, free DLC instead of a free patch[/b]
But, if we're going to do this, we would have to throw in the new backgrounds as well (since there's absolutely no point in having DLC for DLC), and by then, we'd basically be selling the same game as a paid DLC. Which, while it is not unprecedented for a DLC to overhaul a base game's mechanics, it wouldn't serve the original purpose of the remasters, which was for every pre-exisiting and future user to have a retooled game.

2) [b]Only upgrade the resolution[/b]
This way, we'd still be able to sell the new backgrounds as an "HD 4K OMG LOLLERS" DLC for those that want a bit more of the game's backgrounds but still like the base game.

But that would potentially still increase the base game file size for existing users.

3) [b]Make a new Army of Tentacles game entirely, scrap the upgrade patches altogether[/b]
Obviously, if this happened, it would probably be the same price as the original game ($4.99) and use the art from either AoT 3 or [OTHER SECRET IN-UNIVERSE PROJECTS].

While this would be the easiest option, as of now, it's not the most ideal for us. 

[h2]Going forward...[/h2]
No idea what we are going to do yet, but we will let you know when we do have one.

notes.title: Self-Isolation and Indie Development Update
notes.content:
You'd think that self-isolation would be great for an indie dev, right?
Forced to be inside?

Well, yes and no. More no than yes. 

Release dates are all sorts of wacky right now. Halloween Times is going to hit its mark, but Rainbow Hollow may slip.  I recently moved to Boston, and as such, have not been able to fully focus on game development. I'm taking a few days for myself until my work computer arrives late this week. Even then, I'm all out of sorts and discombobulated from both being in a new city, and not being able to get my bearings because of COVID-19 and the mess it caused.  Oh, and I feel like I'm getting sick. No, not COVID symptoms, more like weird stomach stuff.

I've got a schedule, but it is pretty tight, and when push comes to shove, it doesn't look good for the experiment known as Rainbow Hollow getting out anytime soon. I'm much more confident of getting Halloween Times out before summer, and even then, it is going to miss April completely for a May launch. Maybe. We'll see. 

In the coming weeks, we'll be putting up a poll and a forum thread about what people liked and disliked about the first two Army of Tentacles games. Take into mind that we would be revamping the quest, inventory, and attribute/stat systems regardless of comments and criticism. 

Stay safe out there.

notes.title: Argument System 3.0 and YOU!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11959844/47d2f23f1005f186cd14ce7beb36b3b1e57e04ef.jpg[/img]

We at the office have been working on the new foundation code for [b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b], and are so happy with its progress that we have decided to tear out the combat system for [b]Paper Shakespeare RPG[/b] and replace it with the new update to the Army of Tentacles series' Argument System. Honestly? It works better with the theme of the game, and means that we can get it out sooner.

We are still hard at work on a combat system for a later RPG. 

[h1]What will be included in the new system?[/h1]
A much more code-friendly system means that stats will greatly affect the word battles, as well as giving us the the opportunity to make much cooler skills that affect the battles in much deeper ways. 

[h1]Will you be putting Argument System 3.0 in the previous two Army of Tentacles games? Say, before the new Army of Tentacles comes out?[/h1]
I would love to say yes. Let's get into why it might not happen, or might take a while to happen.

Because of the way the original Utahraptor framework (the thing that holds all our systems together in RenPy) was written, it would require a complete code overhaul, and that means an overhaul of two separate games. In that case, we're basically redoing [b]Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] and [b]Super Army of Tentacles 3: The Search for Army of Tentacles 2[/b] from the ground up. 

Even with an existing script to work off of, we're also talking all of the DLC, the works. Everything would be redone. Every scene, every quest, every Argument, every mechanic. Then we'd need to actually take the copy-pasted Argument System 3.0 and make sure it would have the things required for that specific game. 

We're also talking about doing this at no cost to the user, just a simple, free patch. Sadly, we have to weigh that in as a factor, as we do have other games on the slate. We're talking about a 2016 game and a 2017 game, after all. Would we improve the art and resolution for Army 1, to put it in line with the other two games in the trilogy? Would we do art but just leave the resolution the same? 

Is it unfair to any new or existing players to leave Army 1 and Army 3 as is if the new one is going to be, for lack of any other term, badass?

[h1]The Summary[/h1]
[b]Paper Shakespeare RPG[/b] is getting a cooler combat system. Dunno yet if the previous [b]Army of Tentacles[/b] game will get a facelift.

We're very excited to show you the next step.

notes.title: Dashing Dinosaurs & Sexy Centaurs out! New Army of Tentacles coming?
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/947070/Dashing_Dinosaurs__Sexy_Centaurs

Around Early January/Late December, we'll formally announce the rest of our 2020 games. We're finally getting [b]Mythos Ever After: A Cthulhu Dating Sim [/b]done up, and have a new investor for two new Furry/Scalie dating sims. 

This is the reason why we shifted PS RPG to 2021, but we'll talk about that more down below....

[h1]RPGs in 2021[/h1]

We're going back to our roots for 2021, and announcing a new VN-RPG hybrid. Two, actually. With Paper Shakespeare RPG, that rounds it out to three. 

We are currently developing the systems that they will work off, and basically scrapped what we had so far for PS RPG in order to make something that could work peacefully with two of the three games.

Why two of the three? Well, because two are traditional RPG combat, and one is combat via conversation.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/6e57d4eae155f33621726d8b987d863290a365f0.png[/img]

Yes, we're finally getting around to the third and final chapter in our current (and very weird) Army of Tentacles trilogy. We won't be formally announcing with a store page until next year.

It is going to be a standalone game that doesn't need the first two in order to feel complete, and yet will act as a sequel and final entry in the trilogy to those that have played the games before. 

So, next year is gonna be three Furry/Scalie Dating Sims and then Joe Papp to round it out. 2021 is in development, but not active production.

We look forward to sharing more about all our upcoming projects soon!

[h1]NEW GAME AND ANNOUNCEMENTS![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/854530/Paper_Shakespeare_Stick_Julius_Caesar_with_a_dagger/

The final Stick Figure Shakespeare game of 2018 is out. Yummy yummy. Go get it. 

Also.

Schedule has changed a bit. We were steadily working on a game for December, but a few things happened:

1) Our artist suddenly got a bigger contract and could not complete it until later next year.

2) We got contracted to do a game. It's exciting and a challenge for us, as it is a type of game that we have never worked on before.

So, in the place of:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/8f5bea005b5bb98300de4d60d47ef4ce0b317766.png[/img]

We have:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11959844/0c44a16ee4fdd8a90de44000af836bbb38369915.png[/img]

It's a very different game for us, but we feel that we can infuse it with our style as well as do the theme justice. You will be meeting anthropomorphic animals and dragons. That's the deal.

We've done Lovecraft. We've done Shakespeare. Time to do Furries.

Just a quick update. Expect Furries' store page in a month or so, with Mythos' store page by at least summer.

As for other 2019 stuff, we're kind of mulling the idea of an Army of Tentacles prequel which would serve more context for the final Army of Tentacles as well as some of the stuff in Army 3. The final Army game is still in the oven, we've just been sidetracked with smaller projects.

December 2019, if all goes well, should be another medium sized game.

Welp. Hope everyone has a nice day/night!

notes.title: Clarity on bundles.
notes.content:
As we are quickly approaching four games, we thought it best to clarify the categorization and order that our games will be bundled together by:

[h1]Army of Tentacles: Ultimate H.P. LOLcraft Deluxe Platinum Non-Award Winning Pack[/h1]

Will only be adding one new game, and that would be the third and final Army of Tentacles VN-RPG. Since the [b]UHPDPNAWP[/b] is Black GOAT Edition only, we will probably be making a new bundle specfically for Army Next (not its real name) at the outset.

[h1]The Ancient Texts Pack[/h1]

Will include all games adapted from previous writings from members of our company. The two first included will be Joe Papp and Game 5 (which will be announced shortly after Paper Shakespeare's launch).

[h1]The 100% WAIFU Pack[/h1]

Will be all the dating sims. Yes, we said plural. 

[h1]Buy Every Game We've Ever Made (thank you)[/h1]

Will be every game we've ever made. No collections, no DLC, just every base version of every game that we have ever made. Obviously, everything that is not "counted" towards the previous lists ends up here.

[b]A note on packs:[/b] Each game that gets some sort of Ultimate Edition later on down the line will have that version replace the base version (along with all DLC for that game) in the bundle.
